                    ### Question
                    Of the following diseases, one of them can be manifested with absence of jugular venous pulse:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Constrictive pericarditis.
opb. Superior vena cava syndrome.
opc. Tricuspid insufficiency.
opd. Heart failure.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Constrictive pericarditis and superior vena cava syndrome can both manifest with the absence of jugular venous pulse due to reduced venous return caused by cardiac filling restriction or venous obstruction. Tricuspid insufficiency and heart failure are less likely to present with absence of jugular venous pulse as they are associated with increased right atrial pressure leading to visible jugular venous pulse.
